aiResearchSummary.text: Methods for cell culturing describes a method of acquiring a scaffold for a cultivated meat product by forming, crosslinking, and lyophilizing hydrogel fibers to produce crosslinked lyophilized hydrogel structures that support cell growth. Based on this work, Orbillion Bio is researching and developing structured hydrogel fiber scaffolds optimized for culturing cells to produce cultivated meat products, focusing on scaffold formation, crosslinking chemistry, and processing for meat cultivation.
